text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's shaping up looking super 
solid!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
We've improved so much compared to when we 
first started. Fufu... All that practice 
was well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ouch...

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text: ! Eye, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There's a difficult chord to fret... My 
fingers and wrist are just aching a bit.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But I'm totally fine, really! It's not an 
injury or anything!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Beeeep! Overexertion is forbidden, 
Eye-chan! So let's call it a day right 
here! Dismissed!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...No good. I made everyone worry about 
me.
(Paa-pa, pa-ppaa♪)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: This sound is...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ~♪ Ousu!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Zephyr-chan... What a delightfully 
breezy, vibrant tone—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Earth-chan...? An impromptu jam session 
just started...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... such a gentle, soothing melody... 
It puts my mind right at ease—...)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Signorina. How about it? Won't you join 
us in savoring these early afternoon 
melodies?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Um... do you have the sheet music? 
I'm so sorry, I don't know this piece.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Haha—Zephyr and I are in the exact same 
boat. Here, there is no sheet music, nor 
are there any strict rules.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: All that exists is this delightful flow...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come now, relax your shoulders. With a 
free heart, let us perform an exquisite 
harmony. —You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...—! I... I understand. I'll give it a 
try...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(...—Ah, this is amazing...! Even though 
my chord progression is clumsy...—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Riding on the beautiful flow of the two 
of them, it's transforming into a 
carefree, flowing melody—...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... it feels so wonderful. I had no 
idea playing music freely could be this 
much fun...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Bravissima! Magnificent! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us make our souls resonate with 
passion once more!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Such sudden, fast picking...!?!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Pa-pa-ra-ppa-ppa-!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even Zephyr-chan is...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Not bad! Then how about this!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Following pure impulse... I'll strum it 
all out! My very soul—!
(GYUIIIIIN—!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fenomenale! That was the greatest 
performance, Eye!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The gentle breeze has been 
warmed... and become a powerful gale, 
hasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Layering sounds freely like 
this feels so fresh and new!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(I thought I had to be perfect to recreate 
the impulse I felt that day. But—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(What truly matters is the ease of mind... 
to surrender myself completely to the 
sound...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(That was... the key to unleashing the 
burning heat within my chest—...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the delightful music... I found 
Almond Eye and the others innocently 
enjoying their performance.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Trainer! Were you listening? Just 
now!
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... yes, surrendering yourself to the 
music feels so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Though... I only just learned that a 
moment ago♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was surprised myself. A wild 
impulse that felt like it could carry me 
running forever into the distance...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This is the very passion I was searching 
for. Ufufu... I'm really looking forward 
to the actual live stage now!
